critique.good: 姓名、成绩、总分和两层表头均保持单行；六个成绩列等宽，三个学科组的节奏一致，便于逐行阅读和跨列比较。整表紧凑且各行高度一致。
critique.problems: 没有明显的排版问题；表格宽度接近视口上限，但仍在允许范围内。
critique.cause: 姓名列为67px，恰好容纳46px内容及21px内边距和边框；六个成绩列和总分列均为52px，各有31px内容空间，足以容纳相应的单行内容。

critique.good: 六个成绩列等宽，期中、期末表头和所有分数保持单行，学科分组清楚。
critique.problems: 所有姓名都折成两行，六个数据行因此变高；姓名识别和逐行扫描都变慢，表格也显得松散。
critique.cause: 姓名列仅52px，扣除21px内边距和边框后只剩31px，容不下最长46px的姓名；与此同时，成绩列和总分列分别达到54px和55px。

critique.good: 姓名和分数均保持单行，数据行高度一致；六个成绩列等宽，学科分组仍然清晰。
critique.problems: 六个期中、期末表头全部折成两行，增加表头高度并削弱横向扫描；总分列相对其他数字列显得过宽。
critique.cause: 六个成绩列各为49px，扣除21px后只有28px，少于表头单行所需的31px；总分列为70px，超过其单行内容所需宽度。

r0A.idea: 姓名、各次成绩和总分均保持单行，六个成绩列等宽，适合紧凑地逐行和逐列比较。

r0B.idea: 收窄姓名列并让姓名换行，为六个同类成绩列和总分列提供更多空间。

r0C.idea: 保留完整姓名并突出总分，通过让期中、期末表头换行来压缩六个等宽成绩列。

understanding.purpose: 汇总六名高一学生的期中、期末各科成绩及总分，便于查看个人表现和比较学生之间的成绩。
understanding.reading: 按行查看每名学生的各科成绩与总分；按列比较不同学生，并在同一学科内比较期中与期末。
groups: 姓名是行标识，应与该行成绩保持清晰关联。
语文、数学、英语各自的期中和期末列构成一组；六列作用相同，适合采用一致的宽度。
总分是每行的综合结果，应便于单独定位和跨行比较。
keep_intact: 两位数成绩和三位数总分应保持在同一行。
学生姓名宜保持完整，以便快速识别行。
may_wrap: 空间不足时，姓名可在汉字之间换行，但会增加数据行高度并削弱快速识别。
期中、期末可在汉字之间换行；表头已有两层，增加表头高度可避免压缩数据行。

bad.why: Every student name wraps, making the row identifiers harder to scan and substantially increasing the height of every data row.
All six 期中 and 期末 headers wrap character by character, weakening the comparison between exams while leaving excessive space in the total column.

final.rationale: r0A keeps student names, exam labels and scores on one line, so each row reads as a unit and the paired exam columns are easy to compare. It gives the six equivalent exam columns equal widths and reserves the extra space needed for names. The widths use the entire 431px allowance, leaving no whole-pixel flexibility while preserving the stated one-line content widths.

general: Keep row identifiers intact when readers use them to locate and compare records.
Give columns with equivalent roles consistent widths when their content permits it.
Allocate width to prevent disruptive wrapping before giving extra space to already comfortable columns.
specific: The three-character names need 67px per column including padding and borders.
The six exam labels need 52px each to remain on one line, and the total column also needs 52px for its stated one-line content width.
Those minimum one-line widths sum to the full 431px allowance.

final.tradeoffs: A designer might accept the taller header in r0C to give the total column more emphasis, but its extra width does not improve the legibility of these three-digit totals. r0B gives score columns more room at the cost of wrapping every name.
final.uncertain: The ranges assume the supplied one-line content measurements and whole-pixel widths; small browser or font-metric differences could change the exact thresholds.

A.why: 姓名列过窄，所有姓名都被拆成两行，拉高了每一行，也削弱了姓名与成绩的横向关联。

B.why: 姓名、表头和分数均保持完整，各学科的期中与期末列宽一致，行列紧凑且便于横向比较。

C.why: 姓名和所有成绩均完整显示，三组学科列比例协调，行列关系清晰，表格适合在视口内阅读。

D.why: 姓名列过窄，所有姓名都换成两行，使行高增加；成绩列的额外空间对阅读帮助有限。

reviews.unsure: B 和 C 的列宽差异很小，从渲染图中看不出足以影响阅读体验的明显优劣。

A.why: Every student name wraps across two lines, making the rows tall and the identifiers harder to scan; the score columns remain clear.

B.why: Every student name wraps across two lines, interrupting the row labels and increasing row height, while the score columns have ample space.

C.why: Names, headers and scores stay on one line. The paired exam columns have a consistent rhythm, and each row reads clearly across.

D.why: Names, headers and scores stay intact, with balanced subject pairs and clear, compact rows.

reviews.unsure: C and D differ only slightly in column proportions; neither has a clear visual advantage at this scale.
